md: - **Simhasana Dwatrimsika:** **Koravi Goparaju**, poet patronised by the **Recherla Velamas** – 32 throne stories of Vikramaditya in Telugu
- **Birthplace debate:** most say **Bammera**; one tradition places Potana at **Vontimitta (Ontimitta), Kadapa**

- **Kavitva Vicharamu (1914):** **C.R. (Kattamanchi Ramalinga) Reddy** – pioneering modern Telugu **literary criticism**; first Vice-Chancellor of **Andhra University** (1926)
- **Ramachandra Vijayam:** novel by **Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham**; his best-known novel **Ganapati**, play **Gayopakhyanam**
- **Hitasuchani (1862):** **Swamineni Muddu Narasimham Naidu** – first collection of **essays** in modern Telugu prose; social reform
- **Sakshi** essays (from 1913): **Panuganti Lakshminarasimha Rao** – classic Telugu prose humour and social criticism (not the 2008 newspaper)
